activeChats.sql: select count(*)::int from "chats" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "chats"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) where ("chats"."archived_at" is null and "chats"."status" in ($2, $3))

queuedPrompts.sql: select count(*)::int from "queued_prompts" inner join "chats" on "chats"."id" = "queued_prompts"."chat_id" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "chats"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1)

terminalServices.sql: select count(*)::int from "terminals" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "terminals"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) where "terminals"."service_enabled" = $2

projectReplicaJobs.sql: select count(*)::int from "project_replica_jobs" where ("project_replica_jobs"."owner_id" = $1 and "project_replica_jobs"."state" in ($2, $3, $4))

chatRelocationJobs.sql: select count(*)::int from "chat_relocation_jobs" where ("chat_relocation_jobs"."owner_id" = $1 and "chat_relocation_jobs"."state" in ($2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9))

chatImportJobs.sql: select count(*)::int from "chat_import_jobs" where ("chat_import_jobs"."owner_id" = $1 and "chat_import_jobs"."state" in ($2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7))

projectAutomationRuns.sql: select count(*)::int from "project_automation_runs" where ("project_automation_runs"."owner_id" = $1 and "project_automation_runs"."status" in ($2, $3, $4))

gitOperations.sql: select count(*)::int from "git_operations" where ("git_operations"."owner_id" = $1 and "git_operations"."state" in ($2, $3, $4, $5))

runConfigurationRuntimes.sql: select count(*)::int from "run_configuration_runtimes" where ("run_configuration_runtimes"."owner_id" = $1 and "run_configuration_runtimes"."state" in ($2, $3, $4))
